name: recorded-query-refused
description: RECORDED against production 2026-10-10 with `deno task record`, then hand-minimized per fixture strategy v2. Headers are never captured, so no credential can be in here. Trace id zeroed. A real 400, produced by sending an operator the field does not accept. A query is translated before anything is charged, so a refusal costs nothing. The message names the eight operators and points at GET /contract for the ones each field takes.

body.msg: Field 'current_title' is free text. It takes match, eq, in or exists. gte, gt, lte and lt compare numbers and dates only.
